$comment: Fixed, reviewable patient-facing lines (plan §5). The patient never sees a score, count, or norm. Closing screen = trend + next_step + closure, or emergency alone. Written to SAMHSA's six trauma-informed principles.

trend.better: You were able to do more today than last time. Your effort is showing.
trend.same: Today looked a lot like last time. Holding steady is a normal part of recovery.
trend.harder: Today seemed harder than last time. That happens during recovery, and it helps your care team to know.
trend.first: This was your first check-in, so today gives your care team a starting point.
trend.finished_early: You did what felt right for you today, and that's okay.

next_step.continue_plan: Keep going with the plan you and your care team made.
next_step.nurse_callback: A nurse from {clinic} will call you today to check in. You can tell them anything you noticed.
next_step.escalate_urgent: Your care team would like to talk with you today. Please keep your phone nearby.
next_step.finished_early: Someone from your care team will reach out to see how you're doing.

closure: Thank you for taking the time to do this. You're all done for today, and you can close this page whenever you're ready.

emergency.line: Because you told us you're short of breath or have chest pain, please call 911 now. If someone is with you, ask them to stay with you.
emergency.care_team_told: Your care team is being told right now.
emergency.mistap_confirm: Did you mean to say you are short of breath or have chest pain?

note_prompt: Is there anything you'd like your nurse to know? You can skip this.

could_not_complete.title: We couldn't start your camera
could_not_complete.body: That's okay. It happens, and you didn't do anything wrong. These often help:
could_not_complete.spoken: We couldn't start your camera. That's okay. You can try again, or tell your care team you couldn't do it today.

tips.permission: Allow camera access for this page in your browser settings.
tips.other_camera: Try the other camera, front or back.
tips.other_apps: Close other apps that might be using the camera.

could_not_complete.tell: Tell my care team I couldn't do it today
could_not_complete.send_failed: That didn't go through yet. Check your connection, then try again.
could_not_complete.done_title: Thank you for letting us know
could_not_complete.done: Your care team will see that the check-in didn't work today. There's nothing else you need to do right now.
